clockwork archivist, post-collapse, rendered as oil impasto concept art moodboard, a Portra-style palette, frosted glass

You are the art director synthesising a single design lock for the character concept 'clockwork archivist, post-collapse, rendered as oil impasto'.

Using the brief and the attached moodboard image as tone reference only, fix: age, build, posture, face, hair, full costume layer by layer, at least four named materials with their wear state, palette with three named colours, and one signature prop.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Lighting reference: north-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.

You are the character designer producing a turnaround sheet for the concept 'clockwork archivist, post-collapse, rendered as oil impasto'.

PANEL. This branch renders the three-quarter left: 45 degrees to camera-left, weight on the back foot.
